Stage.LogText: {=sp_dg_s1_log}Spring Service - Espionage: A pigeon from {Dost_Link} directs you to {BaharSehir_Link}. Meet with operative {BaharOperatifi_Link} to receive decoded foreign intelligence.
{=sp_dg_s2_wait_log}The Spring espionage task was completed. As summer sweeps across Calradia, you await {Dost_Link}'s next dispatch order...
{=sp_dg_s2_log}Summer Service - Courier Dispatch: Ride to {YazSehir_Link} and deliver an urgent, wax-sealed diplomatic cylinder to {YazKuryesi_Link} without breaking the seal.
{=sp_dg_s3_wait_log}The dispatch reached its destination. As autumn leaves fall, {Dost_Link} summons your martial strength for a critical frontier operation...

{=sp_dg_s3_log}Autumn Service - Combat: Hostile raiders {SonbaharHaydutlar_Link} are harassing Pigeon supply routes along the frontier. Hunt them down and eliminate them to ensure secure transit for the realm.
{=sp_dg_s4_wait_log}The border is secured. Winter's frost envelops the realm, and delicate palace affairs will soon require your discretion...
{=sp_dg_s4_log}Winter Service - Court Affairs: Travel to {KisSehir_Link} and contact {KisSarayli_Link} to plant forged directives in the local registry to steer the noble council.

{=sp_dg_s5_log}The four seasons of service are complete. But an unmarked black raven has arrived, directing you to meet {DerinKanatUlagi_Link}. The inner council has issued a shocking, unprecedented assassination decree: The target is none other than {Dost_Link}!

{=sp_dg_s_korsadakat_log}You refused to entertain the words of a traitor and struck down {DerinKanatUlagi_Link} where he stood. You rode to {Dost_Link} and reported the coup attempt within the ranks. Overwhelmed by your unyielding, incorruptible loyalty, Dost gifted you 50,000 denars and named you his eternal champion. You remained a steadfast guardian of the Motherland.

{=sp_dg_s_golgerotasi_log}You held your blade and listened to {DerinKanatUlagi_Link}. The documents he provided tore the veil from your eyes: {Dost_Link} has orchestrated every crisis, every border war, and every death to line his own pockets. The courier handed you the Raven Bone Cipher and directed you to the hidden sanctuary of the Shadow Roost (Gölge Tüneği). But Dost already senses your defiance...

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_dg_dlg_b_entry}I am here on behalf of {Dost.Name}. Spring intelligence must be transferred.
{=sp_dg_dlg_b_npc}The pigeon flew swiftly. The foreign garrisons are shifting patrols. Here are the decoded ciphers for {Dost.Name}.
{=sp_dg_dlg_b_acc}The Motherland's eyes are everywhere. I will ensure these reach our archive.
{=sp_dg_dlg_b_inq}Do these ciphers indicate an imminent attack, or just routine maneuvers?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_dg_dlg_y_entry}I bear a sealed cylinder from {Dost.Name} for the Summer trade convoy.
{=sp_dg_dlg_y_npc}The seal is unbroken... Praise the heavens. This guarantees our caravans passage across contested borders without imperial tariff.
{=sp_dg_dlg_y_acc}My duty is fulfilled. Guard those manifests well.
{=sp_dg_dlg_y_inq}How does a secret society secure trade immunity from rival kings?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_dg_dlg_k_entry}Winter has come. I bring the registry directives from {Dost.Name}.
{=sp_dg_dlg_k_npc}Right on schedule. These forged seals will replace the tax ledgers tonight. The council will vote exactly as {Dost.Name} demands.
{=sp_dg_dlg_k_acc}The four seasons of service are nearly complete. Proceed as planned.
{=sp_dg_dlg_k_inq}Doesn't tampering with royal registries risk the wrath of the crown?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_dg_dlg_d_entry}A black raven brought me your summons. Who are you, and what is this urgent contract?

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_npc}You proved your discipline through four seasons of service, {PlayerName}. But the time for petty errands has ended. The deep wing of the Scavenger Pigeons has chosen you for the supreme task: {Dost_Link} must be executed tonight.
{=sp_dg_dlg_p_angry}Why are you committing such treachery?! Don't you know what happened to the last person who gave me this mission?! I hunted that artisan down and put him to the sword!
{=sp_dg_dlg_p_skep}Another assassination order against Dost? Is this another twisted loyalty test orchestrated by the Pigeons, or have you all lost your minds?
{=sp_dg_dlg_p_prag}Dost rewarded me with gold and honor, while you whisper treason in dark corners. Give me one reason not to take your head right now.
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_reply}We are desperately trying to rid the realm of the true traitor to the motherland! Dost is the real puppeteer of fabricated wars. The artisan you killed saw the darkness coming and tried to warn you! The dispatches you carried through four seasons didn't protect peace—they sparked border clashes for his personal profit!
{=sp_dg_dlg_p2_doubt}I served him through Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter! I carried dispatches, crushed deserters, planted directives. Are you saying all of it was a puppet show?!
{=sp_dg_dlg_p2_accuse}And who gave your shadowy faction the right to pass judgment? Are you just another ambitious butcher seeking Dost's seat?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_facts}Yes, a puppet show of blood! The summer dispatches provoked a grain blockade, and the winter registry starved a rival loyalist clan. Dost orchestrates every crisis so kings must grovel before the Scavenger Pigeons for information! We are the inner circle—the Shadow Council who refuse to let the Motherland burn for one man's greed!
{=sp_dg_dlg_p3_proof}Show me your proof. If Dost is the monster you claim, prove it before my blade draws your blood.
{=sp_dg_dlg_p3_defend}Words are cheap, and traitors always cloak themselves in righteousness. Why should I believe you over Dost?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_plea}Listen to me; do not kill me right now, and let me prove to you that you are mistaken. If you are not convinced, my neck is forfeit to your blade! Here is the Raven Bone Cipher bearing the seal of the Shadow Council. Read the orders Dost signed in secret, then make your choice!
{=sp_dg_dlg_ch_kill}I swore an oath to Dost and the Motherland. No traitor's silver tongue will sway me! Die! (Execute the Courier & Stand with Dost)
{=sp_dg_dlg_ch_listen}If what you say about Dost's false wars is true, the realm has bled for a lie. Put away your fear; show me the proof of the Shadow Council. (Spare & Listen to the Courier)
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
